title: Sidecar export edge cases: unwarped sample, far-off tuning, stale analysis, empty folder
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Sidecar edge cases

  Scenario: A sample without a beat grid is exported unwarped
    Given the analyzed fixture sample "free-time.wav" with no beat grid
    When I export its sidecar
    Then its sidecar has warping off and no warp markers
    And the output says "free-time.wav: unwarped (no beat grid)"

  Scenario: A recording far out of tune is transposed as well as detuned
    Given an analyzed sample whose tuning is 70 cents flat
    When I export its sidecar
    Then the sidecar transposes it 1 semitone up and detunes it -30 cents

  Scenario: Audio changed since analysis
    Given the analyzed fixture sample "steady-120.wav" whose audio no longer matches its manifest's sha256
    When I export its sidecar
    Then nothing is written
    And the command fails with "steady-120.wav changed since it was analyzed; run apricity-analyze --force steady-120.wav"

  Scenario: A path that does not exist
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars nowhere.wav"
    Then the command fails with "nowhere.wav: no such file"

  Scenario: Nothing to export
    Given an empty folder
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars" on the folder
    Then the output says "no analyzed samples found" and the command succeeds
```
